additional_info.body:
Dear Magnus,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
Y2 / S3 313581528002
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
4ORLUA
Problem Description
:
Troubleshooting
:
I cannot find anything on the DebugStation since it is showing CanCommLoss error, this indicates that there is no communication to the converter. Please check on-site what might be wrong and take a spare converter in case it needs replacement.
Please test swapping one working converter with this faulty one
if it works we might have some sort of loose wiring
if the problem is now in the working converter, we have a wiring issue
if the problem persists in the same bad converter we should replace it.
For future reference, your case number is
0402005
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
